---
name: Feature or enhancement
about: Propose a new capability or an improvement to an existing one.
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

### The use case
What are you trying to do? A concrete scenario beats an abstract wish — tell us about the cost spike, the workflow, the moment of frustration.

### Proposed shape
Roughly how it would work. A sketch of the API, the UI, or the CLI flag is great. Half-formed is fine.

### Alternatives considered
Other ways you thought about solving this, and why they fell short.

### Fit with the project's vision
Does this slot into a milestone or principle in [VISION.md](../../VISION.md)? If it stretches the scope, say so — we'd rather discuss it up front.
